problem_text:
A network of 11 remote sensor stations requires periodic calibration by a technician.

The technician must travel between stations, and the time required for each leg of the journey is known in minutes:
* Station Alpha to Bravo: 85.0 minutes
* Station Alpha to Charlie: 117.4 minutes
* Station Alpha to Delta: 68.8 minutes
* Station Alpha to Echo: 76.6 minutes
* Station Alpha to Foxtrot: 139.0 minutes
* Station Alpha to Golf: 104.7 minutes
* Station Alpha to Hotel: 54.5 minutes
* Station Alpha to India: 83.8 minutes
* Station Alpha to Juliet: 64.3 minutes
* Station Alpha to Kilo: 77.0 minutes
* Station Bravo to Charlie: 123.0 minutes
* Station Bravo to Delta: 139.3 minutes
* Station Bravo to Echo: 75.5 minutes
* Station Bravo to Foxtrot: 113.2 minutes
* Station Bravo to Golf: 175.0 minutes
* Station Bravo to Hotel: 58.4 minutes
* Station Bravo to India: 166.0 minutes
* Station Bravo to Juliet: 149.2 minutes
* Station Bravo to Kilo: 154.0 minutes
* Station Charlie to Delta: 98.2 minutes
* Station Charlie to Echo: 175.5 minutes
* Station Charlie to Foxtrot: 46.0 minutes
* Station Charlie to Golf: 114.2 minutes
* Station Charlie to Hotel: 75.3 minutes
* Station Charlie to India: 139.8 minutes
* Station Charlie to Juliet: 152.9 minutes
* Station Charlie to Kilo: 185.1 minutes
* Station Delta to Echo: 145.2 minutes
* Station Delta to Foxtrot: 138.2 minutes
* Station Delta to Golf: 36.6 minutes
* Station Delta to Hotel: 85.2 minutes
* Station Delta to India: 41.6 minutes
* Station Delta to Juliet: 61.0 minutes
* Station Delta to Kilo: 100.3 minutes
* Station Echo to Foxtrot: 180.0 minutes
* Station Echo to Golf: 180.6 minutes
* Station Echo to Hotel: 100.2 minutes
* Station Echo to India: 153.2 minutes
* Station Echo to Juliet: 122.5 minutes
* Station Echo to Kilo: 107.1 minutes
* Station Foxtrot to Golf: 158.7 minutes
* Station Foxtrot to Hotel: 86.3 minutes
* Station Foxtrot to India: 179.5 minutes
* Station Foxtrot to Juliet: 186.6 minutes
* Station Foxtrot to Kilo: 213.5 minutes
* Station Golf to Hotel: 119.3 minutes
* Station Golf to India: 45.2 minutes
* Station Golf to Juliet: 79.8 minutes
* Station Golf to Kilo: 120.8 minutes
* Station Hotel to India: 118.4 minutes
* Station Hotel to Juliet: 112.0 minutes
* Station Hotel to Kilo: 131.2 minutes
* Station India to Juliet: 37.2 minutes
* Station India to Kilo: 77.1 minutes
* Station Juliet to Kilo: 41.1 minutes

The objective is to determine the calibration circuit that minimizes the total travel duration, requiring the technician to visit every station precisely once before returning to the initial station.
